say:1:1322403001:1.text: My husband's been missing for three days... Captain Rodrigo, you promised you'd bring him back!
say:1:1322403001:1.source_cn: 我丈夫已经失踪三天了……罗德里戈大人，你答应过我一定会...

say:3:1322403003:1.text: ...I'm sorry, I just... I'm so worried. I didn't mean to snap at you.
say:3:1322403003:1.source_cn: ……对不起，我只是太着急了，不是冲你发脾气。

say:4:1322403004:1.text: I understand how you feel. The guards have been searching day and night. The only place we haven't checked is Duskmire Forest, but you know how dangerous that place is.
say:4:1322403004:1.source_cn: 我完全能理解您的心情。侍卫们连续搜寻三天了，目前只有黑...

say:5:1322403005:1.text: Before he went missing, my husband... he wasn't acting like himself. Maybe he did go to that forest. It's not just him, though. Plenty of villagers started acting weird before they went missing...
say:5:1322403005:1.source_cn: 我丈夫走之前总是疯疯癫癫的，也许他真的跑到那片森林去了...

say:6:1322403006:1.text: Don't worry. We'll organize another search as soon as we can.
say:6:1322403006:1.source_cn: 请别太着急，我们会尽快安排人手再组织一次搜寻。

say:7:1322403007:1.source_cn: 呜呜……一定要把他带回来……

say:10:1322403008:1.text: Sorry I didn't greet you sooner, Magister. That was rude of me.
say:10:1322403008:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，很抱歉才顾得上您跟您打招呼，真是失礼。
say:10:1322403008:1.male: Sorry I didn't greet you sooner, Magister. That was rude of me.
say:10:1322403008:1.female: Sorry I didn't greet you sooner, Magister. That was rude of me.

say:11:1322403009:1.text: But as you can see, people have been disappearing in town. At first, I thought it was just couples having arguments and storming off, but more and more people have gone missing.
say:11:1322403009:1.source_cn: 不过您也看到了，镇上出现了失踪案件。起先我以为是夫妇吵...
say:11:1322403009:1.male: But as you can see, people have been disappearing in town. At first, I thought it was just couples having arguments and storming off, but more and more people have gone missing.
say:11:1322403009:1.female: But as you can see, people have been disappearing in town. At first, I thought it was just couples having arguments and storming off, but more and more people have gone missing.

say:12:1322403010:1.text: I've sent out nearly all the guards to search for them, but not a single missing person has been found.
say:12:1322403010:1.source_cn: 我几乎派出了所有侍卫去找，但仍然没能找到任何一位失踪的镇民。
say:12:1322403010:1.male: I've sent out nearly all the guards to search for them, but not a single missing person has been found.
say:12:1322403010:1.female: I've sent out nearly all the guards to search for them, but not a single missing person has been found.

say:13:1322403011:1.text: So many people gone, and not a single one found?
say:13:1322403011:1.source_cn: 那么多人失踪，一个也没能找到吗？

say:14:1322403012:1.text: Could this be some elaborate prank... or did they all leave Cedartown together for some reason? Have there been any strange rumors lately?
say:14:1322403012:1.source_cn: 不会是什么恶作剧吧……或者是他们因为什么事情一起离开了...

say:15:1322403013:1.text: Cedartown is prosperous, and its people are kind and devout. A few people leaving? Possible. But this many? Something has to be wrong.
say:15:1322403013:1.source_cn: 雪松镇物产丰富，镇民们性情又虔诚温和，一个两个离开是有...

say:16:1322403014:1.text: I know we're already stretched thin... but this is a serious matter...
say:16:1322403014:1.source_cn: 我们人手本来就不足……但事关重大……

choice_prompt:17:1322403014.text: I know we're already stretched thin... but this is a serious matter...
choice_prompt:17:1322403014.source_cn: 我们人手本来就不足……但事关重大……

say:18:1322403015:1.text: You'd do that? That'd be a huge help. The guards have been chasing their tails for days.
say:18:1322403015:1.source_cn: 如果您去的话那太感激了，侍卫们的工作搁置很多天了。
say:18:1322403015:1.male: You'd do that? That'd be a huge help. The guards have been chasing their tails for days.
say:18:1322403015:1.female: You'd do that? That'd be a huge help. The guards have been chasing their tails for days.

say:23:1322403019:1.text: No need. You're already short on people. Besides, we know the Duskmire Forest like the back of our hands!
say:23:1322403019:1.source_cn: 你们人手不足，不用再派人给我们带路了。我们去过黑沼森林...

say:25:1322403021:1.text: Relax! Chippy will be right beside Magister. Nothing's gonna happen on my watch!
say:25:1322403021:1.source_cn: 你就放心吧！满满在主人身边，会好好保护主人！

say:26:1322403022:1.text: Alright, I'll leave it to you.

say:28:1322403016:1.text: Thank you... Your help would mean a lot to us. The guards have been chasing their tails for days.
say:28:1322403016:1.source_cn: 您……您愿意出场的话真是太感激了，侍卫们的工作搁置很多天了。
say:28:1322403016:1.male: Thank you... Your help would mean a lot to us. The guards have been chasing their tails for days.
say:28:1322403016:1.female: Thank you... Your help would mean a lot to us. The guards have been chasing their tails for days.

say:29:1322403017:1.text: Don't worry. Whiteridge always makes sure to reward those who help its people, especially when lives are on the line.
say:29:1322403017:1.source_cn: 事关镇民的安慰，只要您愿意协助我们的话，白山不会亏待您...
say:29:1322403017:1.male: Don't worry. Whiteridge always makes sure to reward those who help its people, especially when lives are on the line.
say:29:1322403017:1.female: Don't worry. Whiteridge always makes sure to reward those who help its people, especially when lives are on the line.

say:1:1322406001:1.text: It's okay! We're here to help!

choice_prompt:2:1322406001.text: It's okay! We're here to help!

say:3:1322406002:1.text: Who are you? I don't know you... I'm looking for my friend, Lev. Am I never going to see him again…?
say:3:1322406002:1.source_cn: 你们是谁，我不认识你们……我要找列夫哥哥。是不是再也找...

say:4:1322406004:1.text: He might still be nearby. Let's look for him together.
say:4:1322406004:1.source_cn: 你的列夫哥哥也许就在附近，我们一起找吧。

say:5:1322406005:1.text: Look together... Yeah... let's do that...

say:9:1322406007:1.text: She passed out! Chippy will hold her!
say:9:1322406007:1.source_cn: 啊……她昏过去了！满满来扶住她！

say:11:1322406008:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you think there's something... off about her?
say:11:1322406008:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you think there's something... off about her?
say:11:1322406008:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you think there's something... off about her?

choice_prompt:12:1322406008.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you think there's something... off about her?
choice_prompt:12:1322406008.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你不觉得她的神情……有点奇怪吗？
choice_prompt:12:1322406008.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you think there's something... off about her?
choice_prompt:12:1322406008.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you think there's something... off about her?

say:13:1322406009:1.text: Just as I suspected! But why would someone use dark magic on a commoner? And where did they even learn this kind of magic?
say:13:1322406009:1.source_cn: 果然是黑魔法！可是……这些人为什么要对平民使用黑魔法？...

say:15:1322406010:1.text: Magister, I've found traces of other villagers nearby. Looks like they just got to Duskmire Forest not to long ago.
say:15:1322406010:1.source_cn: 主人，这附近还有其他镇民的踪迹，应该也刚刚到达黑沼森林不久！
say:15:1322406010:1.male: Magister, I've found traces of other villagers nearby. Looks like they just got to Duskmire Forest not to long ago.
say:15:1322406010:1.female: Magister, I've found traces of other villagers nearby. Looks like they just got to Duskmire Forest not to long ago.

choice_prompt:16:1322406010.text: Magister, I've found traces of other villagers nearby. Looks like they just got to Duskmire Forest not to long ago.
choice_prompt:16:1322406010.source_cn: 主人，这附近还有其他镇民的踪迹，应该也刚刚到达黑沼森林不久！
choice_prompt:16:1322406010.male: Magister, I've found traces of other villagers nearby. Looks like they just got to Duskmire Forest not to long ago.
choice_prompt:16:1322406010.female: Magister, I've found traces of other villagers nearby. Looks like they just got to Duskmire Forest not to long ago.

say:19:1322406003:1.text: No! No! If I leave now, I'll never see him again!
say:19:1322406003:1.source_cn: 不，不！这样我就再也找不到列夫哥哥了。

choice:2:1:2.text: Let's get you back to town.
choice:2:1:2.male: Let's get you back to town.
choice:2:1:2.female: Let's get you back to town.

say:0:1322407001:0.text: Let's look around. Hopefully, they haven't gone too far...
say:0:1322407001:0.source_cn: 我们在周围找找，希望他们不要跑得太远……

say:1:1322408001:2.text: Snap out of it. There's no such thing as a Great Will.
say:1:1322408001:2.source_cn: 清醒一点，这根本没什么伟大意志。

say:2:1322408002:1.text: I am ready to receive your guidance... Please answer the prayers of your devoted follower...
say:2:1322408002:1.source_cn: 我愿意聆听您的指引……回应您的虔诚信徒吧……

say:3:1322408003:1.text: Show me the way. No matter what trials lie ahead, I will follow you without hesitation!
say:3:1322408003:1.source_cn: 请指引我方向，只要是您在的地方我就算赴汤蹈火也在所不辞！

say:4:1322408004:1.text: Looks like they're too far gone to listen to reason. We need to trick them into leaving.
say:4:1322408004:1.source_cn: 看样子这些邪教徒暂时听不进去话了，得想个办法把他哄走。

say:5:1322408005:1.text: Trick them? How? Their heads are filled with nothing but this "Great Will" garbage!
say:5:1322408005:1.source_cn: 哄？要怎么哄？他们脑子里只有那个什么“伟大意志”！

choice_prompt:6:1322408005.text: Trick them? How? Their heads are filled with nothing but this "Great Will" garbage!
choice_prompt:6:1322408005.source_cn: 哄？要怎么哄？他们脑子里只有那个什么“伟大意志”！

say:8:1322408007:1.text: Devoted followers! Heed the voice of the divine! The Great Will beckons you forward. Follow us!
say:8:1322408007:1.source_cn: 虔诚的信徒们，聆听神的引导！伟大意志就在前方，跟随我们...

say:9:1322408008:1.text: The Great Will... I think I can hear it! I'm coming! I will follow you to the end of the world!
say:9:1322408008:1.source_cn: 伟大意志，我……似乎听到您的声音了！我来了，我永远跟随您！

say:10:1322408009:1.text: You're disturbingly good at this, Hammie.

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 那就假扮成伟大意志的引导者

say:0:1322408101:0.text: There are more footprints down the road. Let's keep going.
say:0:1322408101:0.source_cn: 足迹还在继续，我们往里走看看吧。

say:1:1322409001:0.text: I'm ready to leave Vera, my beloved wife. My soul is yours to guide...
say:1:1322409001:0.source_cn: 我愿意抛下自己最爱的妻子薇拉，来追随您的脚步……

say:2:1322409002:1.text: That's the guy who ditched his wife. Ugh, those life-wrecking cults!
say:2:1322409002:1.source_cn: 丢下妻子离开的就是他吧，这些乱七八糟的邪教真是太害人了！

say:3:1322409003:1.text: Keep up! The Great Will is just ahead!
say:3:1322409003:1.source_cn: 跟上来，跟我们走！伟大意志就在前方！

say:0:1322409101:0.text: Magister, there are more citizens over there!

say:1:1322410001:1.text: To follow the Great Will is to escape this wretched, rotting world...
say:1:1322410001:1.source_cn: 只要聆听到伟大意志的指引，就可以摆脱这污浊绝望的世界……

say:2:1322410002:1.text: "Wretched"? "Rotting"? You were living just fine in Cedartown—food, shelter, warm bed. What more do you want?
say:2:1322410002:1.source_cn: 污浊绝望？可是……你们在雪松镇的时候也都是能够吃饱穿暖的啊？

say:4:1322410004:1.text: Words spoken against the faith... they taint the soul... corrupt the mind...
say:4:1322410004:1.source_cn: 信仰之外的言辞只会让我心生杂念……口吐浊气……

say:5:1322410005:1.text: It's no use, Chippy. Let's just get them back to town first.
say:5:1322410005:1.source_cn: 没用的，满满。只能先这样把他们带回镇子里了。

say:6:1322410006:1.text: Ah! The Great Will has shown itself! Follow me!
say:6:1322410006:1.source_cn: 啊！我看到伟大意志了，跟上我！

say:7:1322410007:1.text: It's you... You finally found me! Praise be to the one true god! I'm coming!
say:7:1322410007:1.source_cn: 是您……您终于找到我了！赞美唯一的真神！我这就来！

say:1:1322411001:1.text: Magister, we've reached the end of the trail. There are no other villagers nearby.
say:1:1322411001:1.source_cn: 主人，踪迹到此为止，应该没有其他镇民了。
say:1:1322411001:1.male: Magister, we've reached the end of the trail. There are no other villagers nearby.
say:1:1322411001:1.female: Magister, we've reached the end of the trail. There are no other villagers nearby.

choice_prompt:2:1322411001.text: Magister, we've reached the end of the trail. There are no other villagers nearby.
choice_prompt:2:1322411001.source_cn: 主人，踪迹到此为止，应该没有其他镇民了。
choice_prompt:2:1322411001.male: Magister, we've reached the end of the trail. There are no other villagers nearby.
choice_prompt:2:1322411001.female: Magister, we've reached the end of the trail. There are no other villagers nearby.

say:3:1322411003:1.text: Not even the great Merlin could shake them out of this? Guess our best bet is to bring them back first.
say:3:1322411003:1.source_cn: 啊，连梅林都没办法立刻让他们变得清醒吗？听起来我们只能...
say:3:1322411003:1.male: Not even the great Merlin could shake them out of this? Guess our best bet is to bring them back first.
say:3:1322411003:1.female: Not even the great Merlin could shake them out of this? Guess our best bet is to bring them back first.

say:4:1322411004:1.text: There are so many of them... What now?

say:5:1322411005:1.text: Hammie, looks like you're up again. That trick worked like a charm!
say:5:1322411005:1.source_cn: 只能拜托你了，漫漫，你刚才那招很管用！

say:6:1322411006:1.text: WHAT?! We're miles from town! You want me to keep shouting about the "Great Will" the whole way back?
say:6:1322411006:1.source_cn: 什么！这里离雪松镇那么远，我要一直喊着“伟大意志”把他...

say:7:1322411007:1.text: Hey, don't look at me. I've already got my hands full carrying the girl.
say:7:1322411007:1.source_cn: 别看着我，我还要背着女孩呢！

choice_prompt:8:1322411007.text: Hey, don't look at me. I've already got my hands full carrying the girl.
choice_prompt:8:1322411007.source_cn: 别看着我，我还要背着女孩呢！

say:9:1322411008:1.text: Give me a break! I don't want anything to do with this cult!
say:9:1322411008:1.source_cn: 别取笑我啦……我可不想跟邪教沾上一点关系。
say:9:1322411008:1.male: Give me a break! I don't want anything to do with this cult!
say:9:1322411008:1.female: Give me a break! I don't want anything to do with this cult!

say:11:1322411012:1.text: The Great Will awaits ahead! Lost souls... follow me!
say:11:1322411012:1.source_cn: 伟大意志就在前方！迷途的人啊……请随我来……！

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 漫漫可是伟大意志的引导者！

say:13:1322411009:1.text: Absolutely not! <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s voice is meant for elegant incantations, not cult nonsense!
say:13:1322411009:1.male: Absolutely not! <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s voice is meant for elegant incantations, not cult nonsense!
say:13:1322411009:1.female: Absolutely not! <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s voice is meant for elegant incantations, not cult nonsense!

say:14:1322411010:1.text: No chance! No way is Chippy letting Magister do the heavy work!
say:14:1322411010:1.source_cn: 那怎么可以！满满在是绝不会让主人负重的！
say:14:1322411010:1.male: No chance! No way is Chippy letting Magister do the heavy work!
say:14:1322411010:1.female: No chance! No way is Chippy letting Magister do the heavy work!

choice:8:2:3.text: I can carry her if needed.
choice:8:2:3.male: I can carry her if needed.
choice:8:2:3.female: I can carry her if needed.

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 他们过于偏执，需要很多时间

choice:2:1:2.text: Not much we can do here.
choice:2:1:2.male: Not much we can do here.
choice:2:1:2.female: Not much we can do here.

say:15:1322411002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, is there any way to break the dark magic and snap them out of this?
say:15:1322411002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, is there any way to break the dark magic and snap them out of this?
say:15:1322411002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, is there any way to break the dark magic and snap them out of this?

say:0:1322412001:0.text: Let's get back. Rodrigo needs to know about this!
say:0:1322412001:0.source_cn: 我们赶紧回去，把这里的事情告诉罗德里戈吧！

say:1:1322413001:1.text: Sergey, make sure these people are returned to their families.
say:1:1322413001:1.source_cn: 谢尔盖，将这些镇民送回到家人身边。

say:5:1322413003:1.text: Even after the Hierophant Novik incident and the sealing of the Frost Furie, these cultists found a way to persist.
say:5:1322413003:1.source_cn: 诺维茨基大主教事件后冰之恶魔也相继被封印，但邪教徒并没...

say:6:1322413004:1.text: Most of them are locals from Whiteridge. We thought they were just scattered remnants, but we were wrong.
say:6:1322413004:1.source_cn: 他们几乎都是白山本地人，而且只是在附近边边角角的地方活...

say:7:1322413005:1.text: And now, look at where we are. If not for you, I don't even want to imagine the damage my negligence could have caused...
say:7:1322413005:1.source_cn: 真没想到会发展今天这种地步，多亏了你们……不然因为我的...

choice_prompt:8:1322413005.text: And now, look at where we are. If not for you, I don't even want to imagine the damage my negligence could have caused...
choice_prompt:8:1322413005.source_cn: 真没想到会发展今天这种地步，多亏了你们……不然因为我的失职导致任何后果的话……

say:9:1322413006:1.text: Sometimes I wonder... If he were still here, watching over Whiteridge... would things have ever gotten this bad?
say:9:1322413006:1.source_cn: 我时常在想如果那位大人还在的话……白山怎么会沦落到这般...

say:10:1322413009:1.text: First time Chippy heard about this "Great Will" stuff, it was from that old hunter in the forest. What was his name again?
say:10:1322413009:1.source_cn: 满满记得第一次听到伟大意志这个词，还是从森林里的那个老...

say:11:1322413010:1.text: Rezek. A devout follower of Dura. Back then, we thought it was just some religious hogwash. Turns out, it was the beginning of something far worse.
say:11:1322413010:1.source_cn: 雷兹克。我记得他是位虔诚的艾雅信徒，所以当时我们都只是...

say:12:1322413011:1.text: I'm worried Cedartown is just the start... These cultists might have something much bigger planned!
say:12:1322413011:1.source_cn: 我担心……雪松镇只是这群邪教徒传教的开端，他们或许还有...

say:13:1322413012:1.text: Yes! If we stop them now, we won't just be saving Whiteridge. We might be saving countless others in Esperia, too.
say:13:1322413012:1.source_cn: 是的！如果能阻止他们的话，不光是白山，你也许拯救了伊索...

say:14:1322413013:1.text:
Saving... countless others...
You're right. No time for regrets.
say:14:1322413013:1.source_cn: 拯救……更多平民……\n你们说得对，现在不是说丧气话的时候。

say:15:1322413014:1.text: Magister, do you remember the court mage Cyran?
say:15:1322413014:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，不知道您是否记得宫廷魔法师迪尔格雷。
say:15:1322413014:1.male: Magister, do you remember the court mage Cyran?
say:15:1322413014:1.female: Magister, do you remember the court mage Cyran?

choice_prompt:16:1322413014.text: Magister, do you remember the court mage Cyran?
choice_prompt:16:1322413014.source_cn: 魔法师大人，不知道您是否记得宫廷魔法师迪尔格雷。
choice_prompt:16:1322413014.male: Magister, do you remember the court mage Cyran?
choice_prompt:16:1322413014.female: Magister, do you remember the court mage Cyran?

say:17:1322413016:2.text: I remember he spoke to the Archduke about the Great Will. He even tempted him with the idea of resurrecting the princess, leading him astray. If that was true...
say:17:1322413016:2.source_cn: 我记得在城堡幻境中，迪尔格雷曾向大公提到过伟大意志，还...

say:18:1322413017:1.text: Then Cyran is involved in all this. But he disappeared after that. Wiped out every trace of himself. No clues, no leads.
say:18:1322413017:1.source_cn: 如果都是真的，这个迪尔格雷就很有问题。不过那之后，迪尔...

say:19:1322413018:1.text: Whether he's involved or not, we have to put an end to this cult... We can't let them go on ruining any more lives in Whiteridge.
say:19:1322413018:1.source_cn: 但无论这件事是否于他有关，都必须彻底在白山剿灭这些邪教...

say:20:1322413019:1.text: But we can't do this with just the town guards... Magister, will you help us investigate?
say:20:1322413019:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，这件事可能光靠侍卫们的力量是不够的……您能...
say:20:1322413019:1.male: But we can't do this with just the town guards... Magister, will you help us investigate?
say:20:1322413019:1.female: But we can't do this with just the town guards... Magister, will you help us investigate?

choice_prompt:21:1322413019.text: But we can't do this with just the town guards... Magister, will you help us investigate?
choice_prompt:21:1322413019.source_cn: 魔法师大人，这件事可能光靠侍卫们的力量是不够的……您能来协助调查吗？
choice_prompt:21:1322413019.male: But we can't do this with just the town guards... Magister, will you help us investigate?
choice_prompt:21:1322413019.female: But we can't do this with just the town guards... Magister, will you help us investigate?

say:22:1322413020:1.text: Whiteridge will always remember what you've done.
say:22:1322413020:1.male: Whiteridge will always remember what you've done.
say:22:1322413020:1.female: Whiteridge will always remember what you've done.

say:23:1322413023:1.text: Before you start investigating, is there anything else you want to know about the situation?
say:23:1322413023:1.source_cn: 在这之前，关于这次事件您有什么想要了解的吗？
say:23:1322413023:1.male: Before you start investigating, is there anything else you want to know about the situation?
say:23:1322413023:1.female: Before you start investigating, is there anything else you want to know about the situation?

choice_prompt:24:1322413023.text: Before you start investigating, is there anything else you want to know about the situation?

choice_prompt:24:1322413023.male: Before you start investigating, is there anything else you want to know about the situation?
choice_prompt:24:1322413023.female: Before you start investigating, is there anything else you want to know about the situation?

say:25:1322413024:1.text: Her name is Irina. She's the daughter of Darrin, the town drunk. Had trouble speaking since she was little.
say:25:1322413024:1.source_cn: 那个女孩名叫伊琳娜，是镇上酒鬼德米特里的女儿，从小讲话...

say:26:1322413025:1.text: Her father's always been too deep in the bottle to care for her, so no one even noticed when she disappeared. Those damn cultists... they didn't even spare a child.
say:26:1322413025:1.source_cn: 她父亲整日酗酒，对她的关注也很少，所以失踪这么久都没人...

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 关于黑沼森林送回来的女孩

say:27:1322413026:1.text: I know every single resident of Cedartown, and I've never heard that name before.
say:27:1322413026:1.source_cn: 我记得每一个雪松镇民的名字，但列夫这个名字我没有印象。

say:28:1322413027:1.text: I'll leave you to investigate, then.
say:28:1322413027:1.source_cn: 那么，调查的事就拜托您了。
say:28:1322413027:1.male: I'll leave you to investigate, then.
say:28:1322413027:1.female: I'll leave you to investigate, then.

say:30:1322413021:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll always remember what you've done for us...
say:30:1322413021:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll always remember what you've done for us...
say:30:1322413021:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll always remember what you've done for us...

say:31:1322413022:1.text: If they think they can hurt people in Whiteridge and get away with it... they're dead wrong!
say:31:1322413022:1.source_cn: 是的，邪教徒胆敢威胁到白山平民安危的话……我绝不饶恕……

choice:21:2:3.source_cn: 我早就看邪教徒不爽了

choice:16:0:1.text: He was seen at the castle.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 他在城堡幻境中出现过
choice:16:0:1.male: He was seen at the castle.
choice:16:0:1.female: He was seen at the castle.

say:33:1322413015:1.text: Yeah, and I never liked the way he looked at us. Like he was sizing us up for something.
say:33:1322413015:1.source_cn: 嗯，我总觉得他看我们的眼神怪怪的，带着很强烈的审视感。

say:34:1322413007:1.text: I just want to protect this land—for the princess, for the Archduke...
say:34:1322413007:1.source_cn: 我只是希望我能替公主殿下和大公守护好这片土地……

say:35:1322413008:1.text: I keep asking myself... if the Archduke were here, what would he have done?
say:35:1322413008:1.source_cn: 我只是一直在想，如果是大公在的话，大人会怎样做……

choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 也许现在察觉还不算晚

cinematic_dialogue:1:1322404002:.text: Get back! That's not your brother—it's a Hypofiend!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1322404003:.text: We need to handle these Hypofiends first!
